# Chargement des packages et du jeu de données

```{r cars}
library(modeldata) # Pour charger les données attrition
library(rsample)
library(yardstick)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
# ou plus simplement library(tidyverse)

set.seed(123)
```

## Introduction

# Analyse jeu de donnée

```{r}
prop.table(table(train$Attrition))  
# on remarque un déséquilibre : ~16 % de "Yes"

str(attrition)
```


# Séparation train / test (par rapport à la variable cible)

```{r}
split <- initial_split(attrition, prop = 0.75, strata = Attrition)
train <- training(split)
test  <- testing(split)
```


# Première prévision

```{r}
fit0   <- glm(Attrition ~ 1, data = train, family = binomial) # modèlme logistique sans variables explicatives (juste le seuil)
proba0 <- predict(fit0, newdata = test, type = "response")
prev_P1 <- factor(ifelse(proba0 >= 0.5, "Yes", "No"), # Seuil usuel à 0.5
                  levels = levels(test$Attrition))
```

# Deuxième prévision

```{r}
fit <- glm(Attrition ~ OverTime + MonthlyIncome + Age + JobSatisfaction +
             WorkLifeBalance + YearsAtCompany + DistanceFromHome + BusinessTravel,
           data = train, family = binomial)

proba <- predict(fit, newdata = test, type = "response")

# seuil = proportion de "Yes" dans le train (au lieu de 0.5)
seuil <- mean(train$Attrition == "Yes")
prev_P2 <- factor(ifelse(proba >= seuil, "Yes", "No"),
                  levels = levels(test$Attrition))

```

# Tables de contingences

```{r}
table(Prevision_1 = prev_P1, Y = test$Attrition)
table(Prevision_2 = prev_P2, Y = test$Attrition)
```

# Score accuracy

```{r}

comparaison <- tibble(
  Modele = c("P1 (modèle naif)", "P2 (logistique, seuil adapté)"),
  Accuracy = c(
    accuracy_vec(truth = test$Attrition, estimate = prev_P1),
    accuracy_vec(truth = test$Attrition, estimate = prev_P2)
  ), # on prend une règle classique
  Sensibilite = c(
    sens_vec(truth = test$Attrition, estimate = prev_P1, event_level = "second"),
    sens_vec(truth = test$Attrition, estimate = prev_P2, event_level = "second")
  ),
  Nb_departs_detectes = c(
    sum(prev_P1 == "Yes" & test$Attrition == "Yes"),
    sum(prev_P2 == "Yes" & test$Attrition == "Yes")
  ),
  Nb_departs_reels = sum(test$Attrition == "Yes")
)

comparaison |>
  mutate(across(c(Accuracy, Sensibilite), \(x) round(x, 3)))
```
